title: 'One Battle After Another' wins six BAFTA awards including best picture and director
summary: Director Paul Thomas Anderson's politically charged thriller “One Battle After Another” took six prizes, including best picture and best director, at the British Academy Film Awards on Sunday. Blues-steeped vampire epic “Sinners” and gothic horror story “Frankenstein” won three awards each, while Shakespearean family tragedy “Hamnet” was named best British…
